rawContent: Although the court found legal grounds to overturn this conviction, it is another blow to these survivors. Yet another example of why #sexualassault continues to go unreported, one more instance of an abuser avoiding accountability & his victims facing continued injustice. #MeToo

While so many are disheartened and frustrated by yesterday’s news of Bill Cosby’s conviction being overturned, @Terri_White articulates what many victims/survivors are facing and may be feeling. #MeToo
